name: Twitter/X with Gemini Image Generation
shortDescription: Combines Twitter/X posting with Google Gemini image generation for creating and publishing AI-generated visual content with OAuth authentication.

rawRecord.name: Twitter/X with Gemini Image Generation
rawRecord.short_description: Combines Twitter/X posting with Google Gemini image generation for creating and publishing AI-generated visual content with OAuth authentication.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables posting tweets to Twitter/X with both text and images, plus generating images using Google's Gemini API. Uses OAuth 2.0 for tweet posting and OAuth 1.0a for media uploads with automatic token refresh and secure credential storage. Includes tools for Twitter operations and AI image generation that work together to create and post AI-generated images directly to Twitter.
